question: A team stores application logs in an Amazon S3 bucket and wants logs older than 90 days to move automatically to a cheaper storage class. What is the simplest way to do this?

choices.A: Write a Lambda function that copies old objects to another bucket every night.
choices.B: Add an S3 Lifecycle rule that transitions objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days.
choices.C: Enable S3 Versioning on the bucket.
choices.D: Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to another Region.
